source_text:
3.26 Τοῦ αὐτοῦ· προφυλακτικὸν εἰς τὸ μὴ
ἀδικεῖσθαι ὑπό τινος ἰοβόλου δήγματοσ Ἐλαίου ὠμοτριβοῦς ˉλˉι βʹ, μυελοῦ
ἐλαφείου νεοσφαγοῦς ˉγˉο δʹ, κηροῦ τὸ ἀρκοῦν τήξας ἀμφότερα καὶ διηθήσας, χρῶ
κατὰ πάντων τῶν ἰοβόλων.
pass_a_gloss: 3.26 Of-the-same: a-prophylactic into the not to-be-wronged by some venomous bite. Of-oil raw-pressed litrai 2, of-marrow of-a-deer newly-slaughtered ounces 4, of-wax the sufficient having-melted both and having-strained, use according-to all the venomous.
pass_b_english: Of the same: a prophylactic toward not being wronged by any venomous bite. Two litrai of raw-pressed oil, four ounces of marrow of a newly slaughtered deer, enough wax: having melted both and strained, use against all the venomous.

choices.why: κατὰ πάντων is against all venomous creatures, not 'according to all poisons'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
